description: Search the orderly CLI command surface available to this server. Use this before orderly_run whenever a dedicated tool does not cover the task. Returns command names, whether they mutate, usage, argument names/types/enums and help. Pass an exact command name (kebab-case or snake_case) for full detail, or a keyword to search. detail='full' includes long_about and complete argument help.

detail.description: summary (default) omits long help; full includes long_about and every argument description.

mutates.description: Filter to mutating (true) or read-only (false) commands.

offset.description: Number of matching commands to skip (default 0).

query.description: Command name (order-place), keyword (algo, predict, history), or empty to list available commands.

name: orderly_commands
title: Search the Orderly CLI commands
